characters.description: The cunning warlord who unified the north. A master of strategy and politics.
characters.name: 曹操

characters.description: The unbreakable shield of Wei. Held Fan Castle against Guan Yu's siege with a skeleton garrison.
characters.name: 曹仁

characters.description: A strategist of shifting loyalty. Served Cao Cao, then Lü Bu, and died refusing to beg for life.
characters.name: 陳宮

characters.description: Eldest of the Qiao sisters, wife of Sun Ce. A beauty whose sorrow was sung of for centuries.
characters.name: 大喬

characters.description: Cao Cao's first bodyguard. His twin halberds fell dozens of enemies before he died covering his lord's escape.
characters.name: 典韋

characters.description: The mesmerizing beauty of the Three Kingdoms. Her charms sway the hearts of heroes.
characters.name: 貂蝉

characters.description: The tyrant who seized the Han capital. His brutality forged the alliance that would topple him.
characters.name: 董卓

characters.description: The 'Pirate General' of Wu. Feared at sea, he burned a thousand Cao ships in a night raid.
characters.name: 甘寧

characters.description: The God of War. His blade is as sharp as his loyalty, cutting through all who oppose him.
characters.name: 関羽

characters.description: Cao Cao's sharpest strategist. Died young, but his foresight won the north before he left.
characters.name: 郭嘉

characters.description: The legendary physician. His surgeries and anesthesia were centuries ahead of their time.
characters.name: 華佗

characters.description: Zhuge Liang's wife and fellow inventor. Her mechanical brilliance built the wooden oxen and crossbow.
characters.name: 黄月英

characters.description: The veteran archer of Shu. Age has not dulled his aim or his fighting spirit.
characters.name: 黄忠

characters.description: Zhuge Liang's successor in the northern campaigns. Carried Shu's ambitions long after the master's death.
characters.name: 姜維

characters.description: The benevolent founder of Shu. Won hearts across the land with his kindness and ambition to restore the Han.
characters.name: 劉備

characters.description: The unstoppable flying general. Peerless in combat, but his ambition knows no loyalty.
characters.name: 呂布

characters.description: The quiet fire of Wu. Burned Liu Bei's army to ash at Yiling and outsmarted Wei for a decade.
characters.name: 陸遜

characters.description: The scholar-general of Wu. Slain by Guan Yu's ghost, but his scheme took the enemy's head first.
characters.name: 呂蒙

characters.description: The young general of Xiliang. His cavalry charges are swift as the wind.
characters.name: 馬超

characters.description: The 'Young Phoenix,' rival of Zhuge Liang. His genius was cut short at Fallen Phoenix Slope.
characters.name: 龐統

characters.description: The master strategist of Wei. Patient and calculating, he outlasts all his rivals.
characters.name: 司馬懿

characters.description: The 'Little Conqueror.' With a thousand men he carved out the foundation of Wu in a single campaign.
characters.name: 孫策

characters.description: The young tiger of Jiangdong. Founder of the Wu kingdom with unwavering resolve.
characters.name: 孫権

characters.description: Sun Quan's martial sister, betrothed to Liu Bei. As fierce with a blade as any general.
characters.name: 孫尚香

characters.description: An archer of unmatched skill and a loyal knight. Served Wu with honor until his final arrow.
characters.name: 太史慈

characters.description: A fierce and proud Shu general. His talents were overshadowed by mistrust and a fiery temper.
characters.name: 魏延

characters.description: The one-eyed general of Wei. His fierce loyalty and toughness are legendary.
characters.name: 夏侯惇

characters.description: A swift and fierce Wei general. Met his end at the hands of Huang Zhong at Mount Dingjun.
characters.name: 夏侯淵

characters.description: A massive, loyal bodyguard of Cao Cao. His strength is said to rival that of a thousand men.
characters.name: 許褚

characters.description: The architect of Wei's civil administration. Often called the true pillar of Cao Cao's rise.
characters.name: 荀彧

characters.description: Proud lord of the north. Vast in power and following, undone by indecision at Guandu.
characters.name: 袁紹

characters.description: The valiant warrior of Shu. His fearsome presence alone can turn the tide of battle.
characters.name: 張飛

characters.description: The 'Great Teacher' of the Yellow Turbans. His rebellion shook the Han to its foundations.
characters.name: 張角

characters.description: Wei's most feared general. Routed Sun Quan's army at Hefei and stopped a thousand warriors with eight hundred of his own.
characters.name: 張遼

characters.description: The dragon of Changshan. A general of unmatched valor and unwavering loyalty.
characters.name: 趙雲

characters.description: Lady Zhen, famed beauty of the Wei court. Graceful and perceptive, favored of the Cao family.
characters.name: 甄姫

characters.description: The handsome commander. His strategies burn bright and strike swift like a phoenix in battle.
characters.name: 周瑜

characters.description: The Sleeping Dragon. A brilliant strategist who commands the elements with wisdom and foresight.
characters.name: 諸葛亮

moves.description: Raises a stone barrier. Sharply boosts the user's defense.
moves.name: 土壁

moves.description: A blazing strike that engulfs the foe. May inflict burn.
moves.name: 炎撃

moves.description: A devastating explosion of flames. Powerful but risky. May burn.
moves.name: 炎爆

moves.description: Strikes 2-5 times with an iron blade. Multi-hit attack.
moves.name: 鉄裂

moves.description: A sharp metallic slash. The user takes recoil damage.
moves.name: 金斬

moves.description: A fearsome battle cry that may charm the foe, reducing their attack.
moves.name: �声

moves.description: A surge of water that slows the target. Reduces target's speed.
moves.name: 水衝

moves.description: Channels the power of wood to restore HP. Heals 50% of max HP.
moves.name: 木癒
